                    ### Question

This patient's disease is likely to also include which of the following features?

                    ### Options

opb. Continuous progression beginning in the rectum
opc. Fistulae and stricture formation
opd. Worse disease severity near the ileocecal valve

This condition is associated with perianal disease, possible presence of fistulae and stricture formation, and features such as cobblestoning and skip lesions.
